# Pulumi

> > Infrastructure as Code platform supporting TypeScript, Python, Go, .NET, Java, and YAML across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, and Kubernetes with unified secrets management (ESC), AI automation (Neo), and policy governance.

Pulumi enables developers to build, deploy, and manage cloud infrastructure using familiar programming languages instead of domain-specific configuration languages. The platform includes Pulumi Cloud for state management and collaboration, Pulumi ESC for secrets and configuration, and Pulumi Neo for AI-assisted infrastructure automation.

## Key Topics

- Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
- Multi-language support (TypeScript, Python, Go, .NET, Java, YAML)
- Cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
- Kubernetes orchestration
- Pulumi Cloud (state management & collaboration)
- Pulumi ESC (secrets management)
- Pulumi Neo (AI automation)
- Stacks (deployment environments)
- Resource Providers
- Automation API
- Multi-cloud deployment
- Policy governance (Crossguard)
- CI/CD integration
- Pulumi CLI
- Package managers (npm, pip, uv)

## Getting Started

- [Pulumi - Infrastructure as Code in Any Programming Language](https://pulumi.com): Homepage: IaC platform with multi-language support, AI automation & secrets
- [Documentation | Pulumi Docs](https://pulumi.com/docs): Docs homepage: IaC platform overview with TypeScript, Python, Go, .NET, Java
- [Get Started with Pulumi | Pulumi Docs](https://pulumi.com/docs/get-started): Getting started guide with cloud provider quickstarts (AWS, Azure, GCP, K8s)
- [Download & Install Pulumi | Pulumi Docs](https://pulumi.com/docs/get-started/download-install): CLI installation guide for macOS, Linux, Windows via Homebrew & pkg managers
- [Why Pulumi | Pulumi](https://pulumi.com/why-pulumi): Value prop: Any language, any cloud IaC with TypeScript/Python/Go/C#/Java

## Cloud Provider Quickstarts

- [Get started with Pulumi and AWS | Pulumi Docs](https://pulumi.com/docs/iac/get-started/aws): AWS quickstart: Deploy S3 static website with Node.js, Python, Go, .NET, Java
